  709|    /** registered HWID devices of one account: GET /clients/hwids/{email} */
  710|    public function devices(string $email): array
  711|    {
  712|        $email = trim($email);
  713|        if ($email === '') return [];
  714|        $r = $this->api('/clients/hwids/' . rawurlencode($email));
  715|        if (($r['success'] ?? false) !== true) return [];
  716|        $out = [];
  717|        foreach ((array)($r['obj'] ?? []) as $d) {
  718|            if (!is_array($d)) continue;
  719|            $out[] = [
  720|                'id'   => (int)($d['id'] ?? 0),
  721|                'hwid' => (string)($d['hwid'] ?? ''),
  722|                'name' => trim((string)($d['deviceName'] ?? ($d['name'] ?? ''))),
  723|                'os'   => trim((string)($d['os'] ?? ($d['platform'] ?? ''))),
  724|                'app'  => trim((string)($d['appName'] ?? ($d['app'] ?? ''))),
  725|                'seen' => (int)($d['updatedAt'] ?? ($d['createdAt'] ?? 0)),
  726|            ];
  727|        }
  728|        return $out;
  729|    }

  731|    /** free one HWID slot: DELETE /clients/hwids/{email}/{id} */
  732|    public function deviceDelete(string $email, int $id): array
  733|    {
  734|        $email = trim($email);
  735|        if ($email === '' || $id <= 0) return ['success' => false, 'msg' => 'bad request'];
  736|        return $this->api('/clients/hwids/' . rawurlencode($email) . '/' . $id, null, 'DELETE');
  737|    }
  738|
  739|    /** drop every registered device of one account; returns how many were removed */
  740|    public function devicesClear(string $email): int
  741|    {
  742|        $n = 0;
  743|        foreach ($this->devices($email) as $d) {
  744|            $id = (int)($d['id'] ?? 0);
  745|            if ($id <= 0) continue;
  746|            $r = $this->deviceDelete($email, $id);
  747|            if (($r['success'] ?? false) === true) $n++;
  748|        }
  749|        return $n;
  750|    }

  752|    /** set the device (HWID) limit of one or more accounts */
  753|    public function setDeviceLimit(array $emails, int $limit): array
  754|    {
  755|        $emails = array_values(array_filter(array_map('strval', $emails), static fn($e) => trim($e) !== ''));

  757|        return $this->api('/clients/bulkAdjust', [
  758|            'emails'    => $emails,
  759|            'limitHwid' => max(0, $limit),
  760|        ], 'POST');
